# Support

Mindflow `2026.10.20` is a source beta candidate with best-effort community
support. After this repository is published, use its Issues tab for defects,
documentation gaps, and focused feedback. A local candidate is not a published
release or a supported binary download.

Read [Installation](../docs/installation.md) first. Include `mindflow --version`,
this checkout's Git revision, OS, the affected command/view, expected behavior,
and a minimal nonprivate reproduction. Include Rust/Node versions for build
failures. Use `mindflow check --json` for project validation; share only relevant
diagnostics. The skill installer can compare an installed package with
`./distribution/install-structuralist.sh --check`.

Do not include private prose, credentials, personal paths, or unrelated logs.
Use the [private reporting guidance](SECURITY.md) for a suspected vulnerability.
There is no paid support or response-time commitment. CLI source installation
is the primary beta route; native GUI builds are optional. See
[GUI limitations](../docs/gui.md) before reporting a known limitation.
